statement: The absorption target belongs to the current fresh family-chain lower-layer package.
assumptions: recognized trigger selects a bounded target
conclusion: target object is available in current-runtime package
missing_hypothesis: target-construction totality for every arbitrary trigger

statement: Self-verification supports the target identity used by the absorption branch.
assumptions: target object is one of the generated lower-layer objects
missing_hypothesis: target identity proof for arbitrary source trigger
caveat: Self-verification does not prove payload equality.

statement: If target payload is a valid bounded family-chain theorem input, the lifted target is refuted.
assumptions: valid theorem input;payload matches target theorem
missing_hypothesis: bounded theorem applicability tied to exact target payload
caveat: This refutes the lifted target, not automatically the source.

statement: Source counterexample payload must identify with the lifted target payload.
assumptions: source payload and target payload are equivalent
conclusion: source branch shares refuted obstruction with target
caveat: This is the main refutation blocker.

statement: If payload/status alignment holds, lifted-target contradiction refutes the source counterexample branch.
caveat: No full status proof is claimed.

statement: If target theorem or source alignment fails, route to named blocker or residual branch.
assumptions: missing applicability, payload, or status alignment
missing_hypothesis: higher-support bound after operation proofs close
